free_tier.stated: 1 TiB of free DataCap per verified client, instantly, via Gitcoin Passport (score >= 20) on Optimism. Fil+ allocators can grant more. DataCap is a one-time, non-transferable credit — 'If a client needs more DataCap, they must request additional allocations.'
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Not free, and this is what kills it. DataCap buys *storage deal quality*, not bandwidth. On Filecoin Onchain Cloud the retrieval layer is Filecoin Beam: 'Up to $14/TiB (≈ $0.014/GiB) egress'. FCSS: 'Retrieval is billed per TiB retrieved, with one free full-dataset retrieval a year'; unsealed HTTP retrieval returns 402 Payment Required per paid piece.

tooling: Lotus/Boost deal-making, Singularity (github.com/data-preservation-programs/singularity), Spade for renewals, synapse-sdk for FOC, retrieval-client for FCSS.
chaining: DataCap is per verified client and explicitly non-transferable; GLIF Verify caps re-verification at once per 30 days and grants from 64 GiB by GitHub account age. Multiple Gitcoin Passports are an identity-farming exercise, not a technical multiplier — and even a successful farm buys storage, not egress.
limits_note: 64 GiB+ via GLIF (GitHub age dependent), 1 TiB via the faucet; deal duration fixed at signing; retrieval metered; FCSS minimum 6-month term.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: This is the closest thing in the class to a genuine free 500 GB+ *pin* — DataCap really does let you place 1 TiB of verified deals — but the requirement is 500 GB–1 TiB/day of *serving*, and Filecoin charges for exactly that. Storage free, egress paid is a fail against hard filter #2.
